column1: # CHAOS-14432: rows = ceil of the largest measured elapsed of 3 main runs (tests >= 5 s). The weight is the rows + the unlisted tests + 190 s per part (3 parts): every part runs the untagged names (tag-only hook) and pays the setup, which the rows do not show (observed part 460-640 s against 260 s of its own rows). This makes the three parts weigh about 515 s each so the plan does not put a second heavy unit beside one.
